inputs.evidence: Distinct observation mechanisms/configurations can be invisible to the current CellUptakeReceipt digest.
inputs.preferred_pattern: typed ObserverBinding/EvidenceProducerBinding digest admitted before or at receipt construction

inputs.evidence: Matched probe arms can differ in an unrepresented execution context and still produce contract-scope causal classification.
inputs.preferred_pattern: typed shared ProbeExecutionContext digest consumed by both arms

inputs.evidence: The current downstream NOT_COMPUTED fence closes a separate positive-seal semantic defect but does not supply either observer-method identity or matched execution-context identity.

architecture_rule.name: MEASUREMENT_AND_EXPERIMENT_MATCHING_WITNESSES_ARE_ORTHOGONAL
architecture_rule.observer_binding_question: Who/how produced this observation, under which exact producer source/config/method class?
architecture_rule.probe_execution_context_question: Were the intervention and control run under the same declared non-intervention conditions?
architecture_rule.non_equivalence: A strong ObserverBinding does not prove matched experimental context, and a strong ProbeExecutionContext does not prove the observation mechanism or its evidence guarantees.
architecture_rule.promotion_rule: Higher-scope causal promotion should require both questions to be answered at the relevant boundary when each is material; neither witness alone mints truth or causality.

do_not_merge.reason: Combining measurement-producer identity and experiment-match identity into one opaque provenance blob would erase distinct falsifiers, encourage overbinding and create a large ambiguous authority surface.
do_not_merge.allowed_reuse: A future single typed EvidenceEnvelope may reference both canonical digests if it remains a projection/binding object and does not become a second truth store.

expected_benefit.quality: Separately blocks measurement-method aliasing and intervention/control execution-context confounding before higher causal credit.
expected_benefit.model_tokens: 0 expected for both patterns; typed metadata/hash work only.
expected_benefit.dependencies: No full in-toto or Inspect AI runtime dependency recommended.
expected_benefit.resource_cost: ProbeExecutionContext research ablation measured +626 synthetic serialized bytes for a matched pair plus one shared context; ObserverBinding cost not yet ablated. Target runtime resource measurements remain unobserved.

counterhypotheses: A single already-existing upstream typed evidence/run envelope may be able to supply both digests without new local objects; Trigger 4 must search exact current source before adding anything.

ObserverBinding may be unnecessary for specific deterministic direct-hook paths if the hook identity is already immutable and source-bound by a stronger admission object; this must be evidenced, not assumed.
Some execution-context dimensions may be irrelevant or intentionally variable; matching should bind only declared confound-critical dimensions.
falsifiers: Find a currently mandatory exact typed envelope consumed by WP507 that already binds both observer producer/config/method identity and matched non-intervention execution context; then retire duplicate local candidates.
Show that observer identity cannot change evidence guarantees for the admitted target observer path; then demote ObserverBinding for that path only.
Show that execution-context mismatch is already rejected at the exact current WP507/510 path; then retire the R6-SEED-012 candidate.
